title: Ebenezer heads for number one as How to Rob a Bank stumbles
summary: Johnny Depp's film is on course for about $20 million in North America on a quiet weekend at cinemas.
body:
Johnny Depp's Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol is on course to be the number one film in North America this weekend, according to Saturday estimates.

The Paramount film took $6.7 million on Friday, including preview screenings. The studio expects about $20 million for the weekend, though rival studios and Variety put it slightly lower, at $18 million to $20 million.

The rest of the chart

  • Last week's number one, Godzilla Minus Zero, is set to fall by around three quarters.
  • The heist comedy How to Rob a Bank is heading for a disappointing opening of about $4 million.
  • Sony's Ghost Soldier is forecast to take about $4.9 million.

Overall, it is expected to be a quiet weekend, with all films together taking about $80 million.

These are Saturday estimates, not final figures. Sources: Deadline, Variety.
